Container.Name: XDCC-Grabscher
Container.Overview: XG (XDCC Grabscher) is a web-based IRC/XDCC download manager. This container packages the maintained Mono/Docker compatibility fork, including native IRC TLS support, NickServ authentication fixes, and modern browser/dashboard compatibility improvements.
Container.Requires: Outbound internet access. IRC servers, channels, and any required NickServ credentials are configured through the XG WebUI.
Container.Changes: Initial Unraid Community Applications release based on XG 3.3.2.0.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: HTTP port used by the XG WebUI.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent XG configuration, database, and application state.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Directory where completed and in-progress XDCC downloads are stored.
